en.name: Stock watch
en.description: Follow A-shares, Hong Kong and US stocks in one workspace. Share watchlists and notes, inspect candlesticks, volume and moving averages, and switch market data providers or use your own gateway.

zh.name: 行情工作台
zh.description: 在同一个工作台关注 A 股、港股、美股：共享自选与观察笔记，查看日周月 K 线、成交量和均线，导出行情。数据源可切换，支持接入自己的行情网关；行情由打开应用的电脑获取。
